purpose: The isolated 3D stack. Separate from ComfyUI/.venv and the cockpit env; nothing here may alter snapshots/pins.json or the pinned runtime.

policy.cuda: pip wheels only: nvidia-cuda-{nvcc,runtime,cccl}-cu12 provide nvcc for the source-built extensions; no Linux GPU driver, no system CUDA toolkit
policy.hf_home: ~/models/hf: 3D weights live in the HF cache inside the shared ~/models tree (ext4)
policy.isolation: one venv per engine + a torch-free funnel venv; a shared env is impossible on the books: torch 2.6.0 vs 2.5.1, transformers >=4.56,<5.0 (DINOv3ViTModel) vs ==4.46.0 (Hunyuan hard pin)

cuda_pip_wheels.nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12: 12.4.131 — ships ptxas + nvvm/libdevice + crt headers ONLY; no cu12 wheel version ships the nvcc driver binary (verified 12.4.131, 12.6.85, 12.8.93, 12.9.86)

conda_toolchain.why: A deviation from the pip-wheels-only rule: pip wheels cannot supply the nvcc binary; conda-forge compiler-only packages fill the gap (no driver, nothing system-wide)
conda_toolchain.cuda-libraries-dev: 12.4 (cusparse/cublas/... dev headers — torch's CUDAContext.h includes cusparse.h at extension-build time; both engines' first builds tripped on this)
conda_toolchain.layout_note: conda CUDA headers live under targets/x86_64-linux/include — symlinked up into env include/ (and lib64 -> lib) so torch cpp_extension's CUDA_HOME assumptions hold

gltfpack.why: the decimate kind's operator (law 16): meshoptimizer's simplifier over a GLB; a classic tool, no model, no GPU, 0.8 s on a 970k-triangle mesh
gltfpack.path: tools/3d/bin/gltfpack (gitignored, like the venvs; outside envs/ so a venv rebuild does not take it)
gltfpack.flags: -si <ratio> -noq: unquantized so the child is plain glTF for a DCC. NOT -sa: forcing the exact count shatters the surface (952,326 -> 13,309 measured), and the mesh's own floor is ~8-10% of source, set by its UV atlas, not by the error budget. funnel.py decimate() carries the measurements; -sa is an opt-in override (funnel.py --decimate-force)

toolchain.host_compiler: g++ 13.3.0 via apt build-essential; the conda env also carries x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-gcc for nvcc's internal host compile
toolchain.cuda_home: tools/3d/cuda124 -> directory symlink to tools/3d/mamba/envs/cuda (a dir-level symlink keeps nvcc's relative self-location intact; per-file bin symlinks broke cicc resolution)

funnel.torch: none (by design — validation/rendering never rides an engine stack)

Hunyuan3D-2.1.local_patch: hy3dpaint/DifferentiableRenderer/mesh_utils.py: guarded `import bpy` (CREXIL PATCH comment). Why: PyPI carries no bpy wheel for cp310 anymore (4.2+ = cp311+; the README's py3.10 + bpy==4.0 combo rotted), and with .glb output paths the bpy converter is a functional no-op (save_mesh writes the GLB via pygltflib; convert_obj_to_glb's OBJ import would fail and return False). Re-apply after any re-clone.
